# ARGUS — Automated AI Code Reviewer & Architecture Guardian

> ARGUS is an autonomous 3-stage AI code reviewer GitHub Action built for developer productivity in the software lifecycle. Named after Argus Panoptes (the 100-eyed guardian in Greek mythology), it evaluates Pull Request git diffs sequentially across three specialized skills: Atlas, Athena, and Hermes.

## Core Capabilities & 3-Stage Pipeline
- **Stage 1: Atlas (`skills/atlas.js`)**: Converts raw PR git diffs into an interactive Mermaid.js flowchart (`flowchart TD`) mapping changed files, modules, and visual control flows.
- **Stage 2: Athena (`skills/athena.js`)**: Cross-references PR code diffs against repository `architecture.md` rules to prevent modular decay and architectural layering violations.
- **Stage 3: Hermes (`skills/hermes.js`)**: Scans modified code line-by-line for technical debt, unfinished `// TODO` stubs, debug statements, and hardcoded API keys/secrets with severity badges (`🔴 BLOCK`, `🟡 WARN`, `🔵 INFO`).

## Universal AI Cloud Provider Compatibility
- **Google Gemini (Default)**: Supported natively via `@google/genai` SDK (`gemini-2.0-flash`). No base-url required.
- **Universal OpenAI-Compatible**: Routes requests to NVIDIA NIM, OpenRouter, Groq Cloud, Together AI, or OpenAI via custom `base-url`, `api-key`, and `model` workflow inputs.
- **Fallback Engine**: Includes an offline static regex analysis engine if API rate limits or network issues occur.
